business: Maketia: SaaS to build a sales page for a digital product, sell it through your own SasPay link, and deliver the file by private link after the payment is confirmed
by_segment: Beginner creator: first product, small audience (under 2,000 followers)
Established creator: already sells by hand via WhatsApp + mobile money, 2,000-50,000 followers
Trainer, coach or small agency with regular sales
why_not: Je vends déjà sur WhatsApp, je vérifie le SMS mobile money et j'envoie le PDF moi-même. Avec Maketia je dois quand même vérifier l'argent et appuyer sur envoyer, donc pour mon seul produit je ne vois pas pourquoi payer 4 900 par mois. Peut-être que j'essaierai la page gratuite, mais je ne paie pas.

Je vends déjà mon premier e-book en envoyant mon lien de paiement et le fichier sur WhatsApp, ça marche. Avec un seul produit et moins de 2 000 abonnés, je ne vois pas pourquoi payer 4 900 FCFA par mois; au mieux je teste la version gratuite.

I don't know SasPay and I don't have an account there, and I don't know who is behind Maketia either. I've been scammed before, so I won't open a payment account and send my buyers to a name I've never heard of just to save time on sending files.

I don't know SasPay and I don't have an account there, so I would first have to open a new payment account just to use Maketia. I already sell with Chariow and it works, and confirming each sale by hand on WhatsApp is extra work at night, not less.

I would open the Gratuit plan, one page for my one e-book is all I have anyway. Pay 4 900 FCFA a month when I have not sold anything yet? No, my data bundle already runs out before the end of the month.
I would try the free page, one product is all I have anyway. Paying 4 900 FCFA a month before I have even made one sale on SasPay makes no sense for me right now.

I still have to watch my mobile-money SMS, confirm each payment and press send in WhatsApp myself, which is exactly what I do today. A nicer page and an expiring link are not worth 4 900 FCFA a month when my buyers already find me on WhatsApp; at most I would try the free page with one product.

Today I already check my SasPay, then send the link on WhatsApp by hand. With Maketia I still check, still tap confirm, still press send, so for 4 900 FCFA a month I only gain a nicer page. I might try the free page, but I would not pay.

With one e-book and under 2,000 followers, the free page covers me, and I would still confirm each payment and press send on WhatsApp myself, so I don't see what 4 900 FCFA a month adds. I might try the free plan, but only after I find out who is behind Maketia.

I'd open the free plan and put my best e-book on it to see if the page brings me more sales than my WhatsApp status. I'm not paying 4 900 FCFA a month until that page has actually earned it back, and I still confirm every sale by hand like I do now.
flip: Seeing a creator I know in Abidjan or Dakar actually using it and getting paid, plus knowing the real company and people behind Maketia and SasPay. Then I'd try the free plan first.

Making real sales on the free page first, like 4 or 5 sales a month, so the 4 900 FCFA is paid by my sales and not by my pocket. Or a lower price, around 2 000 FCFA.

Automatic payment confirmation with SasPay, plus a well-known creator in my niche showing their real sales on Maketia.
Making my first few sales with the free page, or a creator I follow on TikTok showing they earn with it.
